slides.title: What's new in MyGroom
slides.sub: 6 new things, now on iPhone and web

slides.title: Knows if he runs hot
slides.body: Tell the Rug Advisor if your horse runs hot or cold, then see exactly why it picked that rug.

slides.title: Reminders for every date
slides.body: Farrier, jabs, worming, dentist, MOT, insurance. Choose how many days' notice you want.

slides.title: A log your sharer sees
slides.body: Set training goals and log each session, so your sharer knows what's been worked on.

slides.title: A list for the feed shop
slides.body: A shopping list, so nothing gets left behind at the feed store. You asked, we built it.

slides.title: Rabbits welcome too
slides.body: Add rabbits, guinea pigs and more, with care, meds, documents and food, next to your cat.

slides.title: Now in 10 languages
slides.body: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Swedish and Danish.

slides.title: Update your app, or try it free
slides.question: Which one will you use first?
